punchline: At Portland the plane had working gear and no fuel, because the crew was watching the wrong thing.
thirty_sec: In 1978 a United jet circled Portland while its crew worked on a landing gear problem. The fuel ran out and the plane came down short of the airport. The recorders showed investigators why, and what they found changed crew training across the industry. Matthew Syed holds this up against medicine, where errors are less often examined.
